real IndexedDB survives reload, isolates exact contexts and rejects competing stale page writes
two pages admit one original request, actual project ACK loss reopens and exact replay retains one input

changing trusted account rejects old page original before effects; reentry isolates subject drafts

retainedFailures.reason: Aborted native upgrade preserved the database but schema setup raised an unhandled createIndex exception; repaired the actual upgrade catch/abort path without relaxing preservation or pageerror assertions.

The account fixture changed trusted identity before clicking and lost its button to startup authorization; moved the switch to the target real POST and added exact-journal/principal/403 assertions. Separately, successful recovery feedback lived in a child remounted by the refreshed resourceRevision; moved committed feedback to the parent and required it after a gated actual workspace GET. The failed recovery stopped before receipt/SQL checks, so no business-success inference is made from that failed case.

The initial answer page.goto aborted before submission logic, and the plan ACK-loss lookup button remained beyond the assertion window. The latter failed before local receipt assertions, so no saved-local-outcome inference is made. Neither cause was established. Retain both failures and require separate complete unchanged answer and planning files to pass, excluding those whole files from the selected original full run.

The first planning recheck failed at initial fixture POST/projects with fetch failed/ECONNRESET before opening the browser. The response outcome was unknown. An isolated local keep-alive timing experiment returned200 and did not reproduce the reset; no cause is claimed. Require the final complete unchanged planning file to pass after the other browser invocations finish.

inputAssessment: All source/check inventories have zero changed-during or changed-since files and no post-build source exception. The full43 browser invocation has41pass/2fail (initial answer navigation abort and a plan lookup button remaining); preserve it as failed. Final nonoverlapping evidence selects29 passes from the other four complete files and requires separate complete unchanged answer9/9 and planning5/5 runs, plus HTTP14, totaling57 selected passing cases. The first planning recheck also failed in initial fixture POST/projects with ECONNRESET; preserve it and require the final full planning file to run after the concurrent browser invocations finish. Causes of these intermittent failures were not established; do not describe the whole sequence as one green invocation. Exact failed sources and logs remain outside final totals. All browser/rerun artifact bytes and source maps match final source. SQL1..45, Runner/store, contracts and dependencies are unchanged.
scope: Actual Edge native IndexedDB and production local module; actual multipart/Input API/SQLite/file Worker plus existing protected React/CSP/A2A workbench regressions with controlled model outputs and identities. v1-to-v2 preservation, blocked/aborted upgrades, exact byte/hash/selection CAS, native abort, quotas (256 metadata rows use explicit archived fixtures), ACK loss, original replay, READY mapping and T1 removal rejection. This does not implement or test attachment UI, permanent input closure on removed attachment, new-task entry, real model/OIDC/Linux, WebSocket or complete product acceptance.
